The '''Rush Troop Transport Speeder''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] manufactured by [[Mekuun Corporation/Legends|Mekuun Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was used to quickly deploy troops behind the enemy lines due to its turbine booster.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
